opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to a $3,600 entry amount and promotes ongoing financial returns. It describes an account that “passively built, mining over and over and over again,” claims that $3,600 was turned into $30,000 worth of Bitcoin, and urges viewers to “buy as many shares as you can afford to buy.” It further promises that the network effect will pay “10 times more pound for pound than any opportunity out there,” while presenting claimed monthly income split among participants. The mining-pool dashboard reinforces these representations with displayed earned and paid Bitcoin amounts and pool-share percentages.
